"To Heir is Human"
by BioWare

Set in the heart of Cormanthor, near Myth Drannor, a band of rangers, searching for a kidnapped child, has been defeated by a drow army.  The few remaining survivors have given up hope of rescuing the heir to a barony. Who dares face the might of the drow to save an innocent child?

Recommended Levels: 5 - 15
Number of Players: 1 - 4
